`https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.0.1`
Include the header `: YOUR_VT_API_KEY`. | | **3** | Send the request (e.g., with cURL):

It will contain fields like `last_analysis_stats`, `reputation`, etc. | If you run into rate‑limit errors or other issues, double‑check: * That the key hasn’t expired or been revoked. * That you’re hitting the correct endpoint (`api.vtcloud.net` vs `api.virustotal.com` depending on your plan). * Whether you’ve exceeded your daily quota.
